items.title: Wendell Brunious interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 16, 2000 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: And one time we went to Detroit at the Pontchartrain Hotel. And then Gates called “Giant Steps.” And Bags had come up there with his vibes.

ctx.x: He’s still at it you know.

Yeah. And he would practice. Because where I stayed, it was at 63rd and Broadway. And he stayed on 64th and Broadway at Lincoln Plaza. And I used to go up to his house every day. And he would go through some stuff. He was an old man then, he was about 76 or something, 75 or 76. And he was still practicing 4 to 5 hours a day.
